## Instructions 
 
Arrange the symbols in the optimal order. 
 
 
## System 
 
The system relies on a unique set of four symbols, and it is only valid when all symbols are used exactly once. The order of symbols determines the system's performance. 
 
 
## Symbols and Performance 
 
| Symbol | Performance Rule | 
| ------ | ---------------- | 
| A | Best performance when not followed by more than one symbol. | 
| B | Best performance when not preceded by symbol A or C. | 
| C | Best performance unless it is the last symbol. | 
| D | Best performance when it is the first symbol. | 
 
The challenge is to arrange these symbols (A, B, C, D) in a sequence that maximizes their performance based on the given rules.

The optimal arrangement of the symbols is:

D, A, C, B

This arrangement maximizes the performance of the symbols based on the given rules.

Explanation:

* Symbol D is the first symbol, which is the best performance when it is the first symbol.
* Symbol A is followed by symbol C, which is not followed by more than one symbol, which is the best performance when symbol A is not followed by more than one symbol.
* Symbol C is not the last symbol, which is the best performance when symbol C is not the last symbol.
* Symbol B is not preceded by symbol A or C, which is the best performance when symbol B is not preceded by symbol A or C.

Therefore, the optimal arrangement of the symbols is: D, A, C, B.
